visual_review.notes: Autonomously reviewed all372 original chronological H3 frames, enlarged spear grip/shaft/head, shield, face, boots, death anatomy and light/dark alpha; inspected walk seam80/82/42 and actual native Godot overview at gameplay scale. Dedicated spear salute has visible wrist/arm rotation and recovery; walking alternates foot contacts/passing with stable equipment; death buckles to knees, falls onto shield and settles with spear on ground. Original source-wide body scales and corrected anatomical foot anchors retained. Four previously accepted actions preserved. Candidate182 focused checks passed including Normal/Fast/reduced-motion. Plain magenta matte preserves armor colors; inappropriate local edge refinement excluded. Review used ordered frames and native renders, not continuous browser playback or manual playtest.
